titleStmt.title: Office of the Historian — landing page

publicationStmt.publisher: Office of the Historian, Foreign Service Institute, United States Department of State

div.p: Our Office provides information to the American people about the Department and its history; U.S. foreign relations and resources to conduct research on Department records; and responds to content-specific questions about FRUS series.

figure.figDesc: Cover of Foreign Relations of the United States, 1989–1992, Volume XXXI, START I

head.ref: Now Available: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1989–1992, Volume XXXI, START I, 1989–1991

item.p: This is the second of two volumes in the Foreign Relations series devoted to the START I agreement, which President George H.W. Bush and Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev signed on July 31, 1991.

figure.figDesc: Cover of Foreign Relations of the United States, 1977–1980, Volume XXVII, Western Europe

head.ref: Now Available: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1977–1980, Volume XXVII, Western Europe: Canada, Federal Republic of Germany, and Nordic Countries Chapters

item.p: These chapters document the Carter administration’s approach to relations with Canada, West Germany, and the Nordic countries. The remaining chapters in the volume will be released as they are cleared for publication.

figure.figDesc: Cover of Foreign Relations of the United States, 1981–1988, Volume V, Soviet Union

head.ref: Now Available: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1981–1988, Volume V, Soviet Union, March 1985–October 1986

item.p: This volume documents the first eighteen months of renewed engagement between the United States and the Soviet Union.
